# Labster

> > Labster provides interactive virtual laboratory simulations for STEM education, serving high schools and higher education institutions with immersive science learning experiences.

Labster offers over 300 virtual lab simulations across biology, chemistry, physics, and other sciences, aligned with curricula including NGSS, IB, AP Biology, and AP Chemistry. The platform combines gamification with rigorous science education to improve student engagement and learning outcomes in both K-12 and university settings.

## Virtual Lab Simulations - Biology

- [Cell Structure: Cell theory and internal organelles](https://www.labster.com/simulations/cell-structure): Virtual lab on cell theory, eukaryotes, prokaryotes, and organelles
- [Homeostatic Control: How does the human body keep itself in balance?](https://www.labster.com/simulations/homeostatic-control): Virtual lab simulation exploring homeostasis and feedback loops in biology
- [Evolution: Are you related to a sea monster?](https://www.labster.com/simulations/evolution): Virtual lab simulating evolution, natural selection, and DNA sequencing
- [Cellular Respiration: Glycolysis](https://www.labster.com/simulations/cellular-respiration-glycolysis-new): Virtual lab exploring glycolysis and ATP metabolism in cellular respiration
- [Microscopy](https://www.labster.com/simulations/microscopy): Virtual lab comparing light, fluorescence, and electron microscopy techniques
- [Gram Stain: Test yourself in Gram Stain Procedure](https://www.labster.com/simulations/gram-stain-test-yourself-in-gram-stain-procedure-new): Microbiology simulation for practicing Gram stain laboratory technique

## Virtual Lab Simulations - Chemistry

- [Chemistry](https://www.labster.com/discipline/chemistry): Chemistry discipline page showcasing virtual lab courses and simulations
- [Elimination Reaction: Use cyclohexanol to create polymers](https://www.labster.com/simulations/elimination-reactions): Organic chemistry simulation on elimination reactions and polymer synthesis
- [Introduction to Qualitative Analysis of Elements](https://www.labster.com/simulations/introduction-to-qualitative-analysis-of-elements-new): Virtual lab on periodic table classification using flame tests
- [Conductivity Testing: Investigating conductivity and its practical applications](https://www.labster.com/simulations/conductivity-testing-investigating-conductivity-and-its-practical-applications): Chemistry lab on electrolytes, conductivity, and ions in biological systems
- [Homogenization: Developing better-tasting milk](https://www.labster.com/simulations/homogenization): Food science simulation on milk homogenization and emulsifier chemistry

## Case Studies & Success Stories

- [How Yavapai College Boosted Online Completion Rates with Labster](https://www.labster.com/case-studies/yavapai-college-boosted-online-completion-rates): Community college increased microbiology completion rates 14% with Labster
- [Texas Christian University Sees ROI Using Labster's Virtual Science Simulations](https://www.labster.com/case-studies/texas-christian-university-sees-roi-using-labster): TCU case study demonstrates ROI of virtual labs in biology courses
- [Amman Baccalaureate School Uses Virtual Labs to Help Students Visualize Scientific Concepts](https://www.labster.com/case-studies/amman-baccalaureate-school): Case study: IB school uses Labster for gamified science visualization

## Research & Educational Studies

- [Laboratory performance prediction using virtual reality behaviometrics](https://www.labster.com/research/laboratory-performance-prediction-using-virtual-reality-behaviometrics): Research study on VR behaviometrics predicting lab performance outcomes
- [A structural equation modeling investigation of the emotional value of immersive virtual reality in education](https://www.labster.com/research/investigation-of-emotional-value): Research on affective and cognitive paths of immersive VR in education
- [Simulation Based Virtual Learning Environment in Medical Genetics Counseling](https://www.labster.com/research/virtual-simulations-bridging-gaps-in-medical-education): Research on virtual simulations bridging theory-practice gap in genetics
